issue.title: sase xprompt show /name normalizes a pasted skill reference like #name instead of resolving via skill_name
issue.description: src/sase/xprompt/cli_show_resolve.py normalize_show_name treats a pasted '/name' copied reference identically to '#name', so 'sase xprompt show /sase_plan' reports 'unknown xprompt' instead of resolving through skill_name. This is pre-existing behavior pinned by tests/xprompt/test_cli_show_resolve.py::test_normalize_show_name, not a regression, but epic sase-hb made '#skills/foo' and '/foo' deliberately distinct namespaces, so the show surface is now inconsistent with the documented skill_name contract: the one string a user is most likely to copy out of an agent session is the one 'sase xprompt show' cannot resolve. Reported as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by phase sase-hb.5; that epic was closed 2026-08-11 with this recorded as unresolved residue. SCOPE: resolve a leading '/name' through skill_name lookup, update the pinned test, and update the CLI help.

payload.entry: Backlog triage (owner-requested seven-bead cut, 2026-08-12): confirmed still live at HEAD 62951abcb -- src/sase/xprompt/cli_show_resolve.py:69 strips a leading '/' exactly like '#', so 'sase xprompt show /sase_plan' still misses the skill_name path. Real inconsistency with the namespaces epic sase-hb established, but it costs one retyped character and blocks nothing. Reopen with a +1 if the show surface keeps tripping people up.

payload.close_reason: Confirmed live but a papercut; not among the owner's seven
